rationale: Regulator-curated list of the other MK financial supervisors — mine once to seed the supervisory perimeter.
Wayback CDX API gives queryable version history of regulator/gazette pages — core deadline-dating capability.
Secondary archive catching WAF/JS pages Wayback misses; useful redundancy for proving announcement dates.
Official Gazette free-issue page is the legally binding publication point for enactment and transition dates; failed fetch is soft only.
Gazette back-catalogue needed to reconstruct amendment chains behind current banking/payments obligations.
Canonical URL is an unrelated ad/redirect domain with a tracking key, not mkopen.org — junk, do not collect.
Single MoF news item about a portal refresh; the ministry site itself is the monitorable source.
IMF SDDS summary page with fixed release calendar — stable, low-maintenance macro-financial endpoint.
Open-data policy section of vlada.mk; covered by monitoring the government parent, weak standalone signal.
One-off official compendium PDF of financial-system statutes — excellent checklist evidence, not a producing feed.
Parliament session-materials tracker is the primary surface where banking/payments bills and amendments appear.
Finance/economy committee agendas are the earliest public sighting of substantive amendment text and fast-track procedure.
Parliamentary research briefings sit under sobranie.mk /content/; useful context but covered by the parent and URL unproven.
Government session readouts mark the exact handoff of a bill from executive to Parliament; gap-checkable series.
Government press feed announces ENER publication and consultation windows — cheap push signal on deadlines.
MoF consolidated index of financial-sector laws in force; authoritative statute-to-drafter mapping and amendment cross-check.
MoF legacy archive preserves gazette-headed statute PDFs; practical fallback when slvesnik is unreachable.
Economic Chamber posts draft-law and NBRM decision PDFs plus consultation timelines; crawlable de-facto mirror.
FIU statute repository with consolidated AML/CFT texts and amendment history — direct in-scope compliance deadlines.
Constitutional Court filings/rulings are the tail risk that can void bank obligations; confirmed banking caseload.
NPAA is the forward legislative calendar for Ch.4/9/24 financial and AML laws — earliest view of future obligations.
Civil-society ENER monitor gives a ready-made digest of new consultations plus a coverage-completeness calibration.
Consolidated commercial law database of high value but subscription-gated; licence and access must be cleared by a human.
Open, crawlable statute mirror and legal-news feed; secondary compiler, always confirm text against the gazette.
Curated English index of MK legislative sources — mine once as a snowball seed, not a producing feed.
